Name: Aceball
Overview:
Aceball is a pong variant that puts the player in control of a paddle on one side of the screen, and a computer controlled paddle on the other side of the screen with a small ball bouncing between them, and it is up to the player to prevent the ball from getting past his paddle whilst trying to get it past the players opponent. At various points throughout the game, the player will have multiple balls to contend with, but will also have shaped paddles to help get balls past the opposing paddle.

Aceball also features local multiplayer support for competitive as well as co operative games.
